matchafulll.rationale: A deep jewel-green midnight glow with slow drifting light and rising motes reads as a premium late-night matcha lounge — 'a green glow after dark' — never a flat white field.

the-sweet-sip.rationale: Deep jewel-toned night with drifting glows, a soft moon bloom and a quiet twinkling starfield stages the cafe's velvet dessert hour so light text glows against a luminous evening.

harf-cafe.rationale: A calligrapher's open notebook catches morning light — luminous amber paper with faint ruled lines and slow-drifting ink motes, so headings read crisp in the calm bright center.

caia-coffee.rationale: Deep jewel-blue night with a far horizon glow and slowly twinkling motes reads as a quiet city seen from a warm window seat, exactly Caia's midnight world.

shanab-cafe.rationale: A luminous, saturated brand-tinted field with slowly drifting warm glows and gentle rising steam-motes evokes a sunlit family house on a laughing Friday, while a calm bright center keeps the near-blac

hdn-coffee.rationale: A slow breathing dawn-truce sky in the cafe's own palette, with soft drifting clouds and a bright calm center so near-black text stays crisp — the busy day held at a distance.

sharq-coffee-and-roastery.rationale: A luminous copper-and-amber dawn field with embers drifting up from the lower corners evokes a roastery waking before the sun, while the calmer light-warm center keeps near-black headings crisp.

nakhati-gelato.rationale: A deep jewel-toned Riyadh night sky with drifting aurora glows and a soft twinkling starfield turns the page into 'a dessert night under city stars' without ever touching the legible light text.

duirrah.rationale: Deep majlis jewel tones with a warm doorway glow rising from below, like light spilling from a little house at dusk over a faint tile lattice.

cavida-cafe.rationale: Deep jewel darkness with slow-drifting luminous pools and rising sparks reads as one lit corner breathing inside a sleeping midnight city.
